mentions.name: Things To Have
mentions.description: A quirky wishlist app for keeping and sharing lists of things you want to have; recently released, with the builder currently focused on marketing, noting that ChatGPT-referred traffic now competes with paid traffic while offering better audience quality and retention.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have finally released my quirky wishlist app, https://thingstohave.app, that I was covering in multiple previous "Ask HN" posts.
mentions.author: brachkow

mentions.name: thingstohave.app
mentions.description: A quirky wishlist app for tracking things you want, featuring image loading from blur, unadvertised but advanced drag-and-drop everywhere, natural language currency inputs with sorting, and a platform-agnostic quick add. Built on the Cloudflare Workers ecosystem with a custom Inertia.js adapter for Hono and Vue SSR, using an old-school MVC approach with Vue as the template engine; cheap to run and finished ahead of public launch.
mentions.source_excerpt: My quirky wishlist app https://thingstohave.app is finally done and heading to public launch this or next week.
mentions.author: brachkow
